name: Gravedigger's Luck
text: Every item is cursed, but buyers pay 50% more for them.

name: The Blind Lamp
text: The UV lamp fails. You start with 40% more cash.

name: Numb Hands
text: Touch fails. Sellers haggle for longer.

name: The Open Book
text: You know Seal from the start. The wake comes 10% sooner.

name: Hungry Pages
text: You know Banish from the start. Cursed sellers are 20% more common.

name: Gambler's Moon
text: Two table games each night. Rent is 15% higher.

name: The Regular Crowd
text: One seller type only, 15% cheaper. Buyers pay 8% less.

name: The Long Night
text: Days are 20% longer. Curses stir 50% more each night.

name: Landlord's Pity
text: Rent grows slower. Cursed sellers are 30% more common.

name: The Thin Veil
text: Tells show every time. The wake comes 20% sooner.

name: The Hollow Coin
text: Buyers pay 15% more. You start with 40% less cash.
